# IOR 4.0.0 HDF5 Optimization Session -- Quick Start

This package is a self-contained reproduction of session `ior/20260724_175545`:
an annotate -> baseline-trace -> diagnose -> 4-dimension-optimize pipeline run
against IOR 4.0.0 (HDF5 1.14.5, Autotools) on Tuolumne.

**Bottom line:** no measured optimization beat the plain IOR baseline
(`-a HDF5 -b 16m -t 4k -s 32 -C -F`, 512 ranks/8 nodes) outside its own
measurement noise. Full detail, every number, every rejected variant, the
session's chronological narrative, and a resume-point to-do list for a
future session are in **`REPORT.md`** (also rendered as `REPORT.pdf`).

## Reproduce it

1. Fill in `config.ini`: set `WORKSPACE_ROOT` to a scratch directory and
   `OUTPUT_ROOT` to a directory isolated from any real run data.
2. `bash scripts/install.sh` -- rebuilds HDF5 1.14.5 from source, installs
   dftracer (FUNCTION mode only, never LD_PRELOAD), builds the annotated IOR
   binary against both.
3. `bash scripts/run_all.sh <alloc-id>` -- runs the baseline and every
   optimization-variant script in order, each into its own fresh subdirectory
   under `$OUTPUT_ROOT`.
4. Compare the printed write/read median bandwidth against the ranges in
   `REPORT.md` Section 7b -- reproduction is successful if the new numbers
   fall within (or close to, accounting for site-specific filesystem drift)
   the reported ranges.

## What's in here

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `REPORT.md` / `REPORT.pdf` | Full report: bottleneck diagnosis, every optimization variant tried (applied and rejected), the N-way comparator table, chronological session narrative, and a resume-point to-do list |
| `config.ini` | The ONLY file with real path/session values -- everything else is placeholder-only |
| `scripts/lib_load_config.sh` | Sourced by every other script; reads `config.ini` |
| `scripts/install.sh` | Rebuilds HDF5 + dftracer + annotated IOR |
| `scripts/run_*.sh` | One wrapper per run this session actually executed (baseline, I/O variants, communication variants, config/build helper scripts, incrementally discovered from every `tmp/*.sh` this session used) |
| `scripts/render_pdf.sh` + `scripts/_render_pdf.py` | Regenerates `REPORT.pdf`/`README.pdf` from the markdown (pure-Python, no sudo -- see script header) |
| `patches/annotated.patch` | Full source diff: dftracer annotation macros added to IOR's C sources, plus the `AC_PREREQ` build fix |
| `plan/` | The pipeline plan this session actually executed |
| `PERFORMANCE.md` | Pipeline self-profiling (step timings, retries) |

## Notes

- Every optimization-variant script launches with dftracer tracing
  **disabled** (`DFTRACER_ENABLE=0`) except the dedicated baseline-trace
  script -- this session found and fixed a real methodology bug where mixing
  traced and untraced arms in one A/B inflated apparent gains by ~60% (see
  REPORT.md Lessons Learned / Session Narrative).
- No script in this package hardcodes an absolute path, username, or
  allocation id -- everything routes through `config.ini` via
  `scripts/lib_load_config.sh`.
- Raw run/build logs are intentionally NOT included in this package (they
  stay in the session workspace's own `artifacts/` dir) -- only scripts,
  patches, params, config, and narrative docs are shipped here.
